role: CI gate (ci.yml thread-sanitizer job when inputs.scope != 'gates'; make thread-sanitizer, a prerequisite of make ci) that runs the EmuquTests unit target under Thread Sanitizer and fails on any TSan warning, any test failure, or a run in which no test case executed.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh (no cd to repo root; relies on cwd). DESTINATION defaults to select_simulator_destination.sh output. gate_mktemp log (exit on failure). Runs `xcodebuild test -enableThreadSanitizer YES -only-testing:EmuquTests` into the log with set +e; gate_require_nonempty on the log (empty -> exit 70). Counts 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer' lines, and test CASE results only: lines matching `Test [Cc]ase '<name>' passed` / `... failed` (serial `Test Case '-[...]'` and parallel-worker `Test case '...' passed on 'Clone ...'` formats; `Test Suite` lines are not counted). races>0 -> prints 20 lines after each warning, exit 1. status != 0: if failed>0 prints the first 20 `' failed` lines; else greps build-error markers (both greps `|| true`, so no match or SIGPIPE cannot end the script) and tails 40 log lines; exits with xcodebuild's status. status 0 with zero passed test cases -> prints an error and the last 40 log lines, exit 1 (zero races from zero tests is not a pass). Else appends the race and passed-test counts to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set.
